'''Starsnow''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and the son of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Starsnow (Senator)|Starsnow]]. He died during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], and his journal was recovered by a traveling hero for Starsnow's father.<ref name="TOR" />
